rawProofCommandBoundary: Hermetic in-memory proof only. It exercises the USF notification capability, local enterprise notification control plane, synthetic tenants, synchronous PDP decisions, value-free audit evidence, and no live email, SMS, push, webhook, SMTP, provider deliverability, UI, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim.
nonClaims: No full dev readiness, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, deployment readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, enterprise production readiness, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
Hermetic notifications proof does not prove live email, SMS, push, webhook, SMTP, Brevo, Mailpit-as-deliverability-provider, or external provider readiness.

Bounded local feedback and unsubscribe ingestion proof does not prove live webhook callback compatibility, provider replay, provider SLA, bounce/complaint deliverability, or external suppression-list readiness.

Local API contract and capability proof does not prove public notification API readiness, browser UI readiness, customer messaging workflows, environment promotion, or production notification operation.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Each deferred notifications control is implemented with proof or explicitly reclassified.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: Controls below record bounded-local-proof for persistence/outbox, provider feedback ingestion, unsubscribe ingestion, retention purge, bulk runtime, rate limit, address verification, and provider circuit breaker. API is reclassified as an explicit non-equivalent local substitute, UI and live deliverability remain deferred with owner and review date.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Provider feedback, unsubscribe, retention, and bulk boundaries are explicit where claimed.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: provider-feedback-ingestion, unsubscribe-ingestion, retention-purge-legal-hold, and bulk-campaign-runtime rows include proof commands, non-equivalence boundaries, and live/provider-deliverability non-claims.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Tenant, access, audit, secret, and redaction evidence exists where claimed.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: make notify-proof records enterpriseNotificationEvidence flags for tenantBoundaryChecked, accessBoundaryChecked, auditEvidenceCaptured, secretBoundaryChecked, redactionChecked, and providerSubstituteBoundaryChecked. Tests cover tenant denial, PDP denial, redacted audit, and value-free provider failure evidence.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Validator coverage exists for any new notification claim.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: USF-NOTIFY-017 through USF-NOTIFY-021 validate the enterprise control-plane helper, proof markers, matrix completeness, enterprise evidence rows, and prohibited readiness/live-deliverability claims.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: No live provider or deliverability readiness claim is made without proof.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: claims object and proof result set liveProviderReadinessClaim, deliverabilityReadinessClaim, stagingReadinessClaim, productionReadinessClaim, SOC readiness, ISO certification, full-dev, full-parity, and USF-133 closure claims to false.
